purpose: Direct descriptive comparison of two saved schedules, not online policy or general model validation
repeats_meaning: Two observations per schedule with reversed pair order; descriptive spread only, not a precision guarantee or independent model validation
schedule: Original arrivals, fixed backend and saved dispatch lower bound; actual duration/lane release never forced; no +35 second release shift
primary_energy: Observed whole-device current raw=mA conditional integral over original 0..120 seconds, complete brackets required
AP: Observed initial/peak/change and recorded path; no preload candidate when 55 second preload is unavailable; no new AP fitting
service: All 24 planned requests retained; output_ready for urgent, persist_complete for normal; report completion, timely count and response P95
comparison: B2 minus CPU within each prespecified pair; display both differences, their mean and raw range; no confidence or superiority PASS from n=2
environment: Same signed APK, four resident runtimes and eight warmups per session; existing unplugged/BAT/thermal/screen/memory/quality criteria unchanged; AP observe-v2 freshness, no development lower bound
model: Original state power arithmetic can be shown only as short-transition diagnostic, not strict supported energy; no recalibration
failure: First failure stops this plan, preserves partial observations and cleanup; no retry in the same plan. Any later correction/run requires a distinct evidence-preserving plan and known cause; user allows necessary correction but not success-threshold relaxation.
missing: null, never zero fill or shift a window; partial sessions never count as complete pairs
